profile.headline: Software Engineer | Python, TypeScript & React | Jupyter Ecosystem | Developer Tools | Open Source
profile.summary:
Software engineer with 4+ years of experience building developer tools, web applications, and open-source software using Python and TypeScript.
I started my career in full-stack development, building projects across the stack, from GraphQL APIs and relational database design to React frontends and a security-focused Electron desktop app. That foundation led me into open-source development in the Jupyter ecosystem.
At Anaconda, I've contributed to open-source projects used by developers and data scientists around the world, maintaining projects in the JupyterLab ecosystem, and building JupyterLab extensions, alongside broader community involvement. More recently, my work has expanded into product engineering, where I help build and maintain customer-facing applications using Python, TypeScript, Angular, and modern web technologies.
I enjoy working across the stack, solving complex technical problems, and building software that improves the developer experience.
Technologies I regularly work with include Python, TypeScript, React, JupyterLab, SQL, Git, and CI/CD workflows.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Maintained open-source projects in the Jupyter ecosystem and built Python packages and JupyterLab extensions used by developers and data scientists worldwide.
 
Collaborated with distributed open-source communities to design, implement, and review features and bug fixes, while improving testing and packaging workflows to support more reliable and maintainable releases.
 
Participated in community initiatives, including triage groups, the Jupyter Community Building Working Group, and organizing the community call.

Built customer-facing product features using Python and TypeScript, driving work from technical design through implementation, testing, and release.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Conducted technical interviews for prospective engineers evaluating intermediate to advanced JavaScript principles.

Presented detailed code reviews of algorithms, focusing on time/space complexity optimizations and debugging.

Provided technical mentorship to junior engineers, through the development of full-stack applications, and agile/scrum methods. 

Delivered instruction on topics such as Async/Await and Promises, Linked Lists and BSTs and sorting algorithms.

positions.title: Pickle | web application that serves as a quirky buy nothing community forum
positions.description:
Created a GraphQL API with Apollo Server and Express, with optimized data fetching, and use of built-in type checking and customized request data.  

Utilized Prisma with a PostgresQL database containerized in Docker for an improved development environment in terms of consistency.

Employed the use of Sass with a 7 in 1 architecture for modularity and reusability of styles as well as clear style nesting.

positions.title: TAG Inc. | web application that provides ticketing service for IT freelancers
positions.description:
Created a Node.js and Express server to implement a RESTful API with an MVC application design pattern, developing the corresponding routers and controllers.

Used HTML5 and CSS3 flexbox, grids and media queries to create designs responsive to multiple devices.

Designed a SQL database that modeled a ticketing system, leveraged ACID compliance of transactions and provided scalability and data integrity.

positions.title: Rentaly | web application that provides rental recommendations to market investors
positions.description:
Utilized the Rapid API Marketplace Zillow API and the Mapbox API to display rental properties on an interactive map with location markers using a geocoder,  offering light and dark modes, in compliance with terms of use.

Used React Router to efficiently handle dynamic routing and customized route navigations.

Implemented Google OAuth 2.0 to allow for secure user login and signup, as well as to expand platform accessibility.

Utilized React for frontend development using React Hooks to use local state to manage data for UI reactivity and allow for reusability.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Desktop application that identifies settings that pose security risks in Electron applications.

Created an Electron application written in Typescript with a React frontend for reliable and intentional system design.

Used Tailwind CSS to apply consistent and customized component styling for a clean UI and improved user experience.

Utilized Electron’s contextBridge to create a bi-directional bridge between isolated contexts for optimal application security when loading or using remote content.

Leveraged Typescript Estree, the abstract syntax tree generating tool, to identify security settings in Electron applications and implemented logic that would lead us to making appropriate code modifications using the API wrapper TS Morph.

Product developed under tech accelerator OSLabs.

company.name: NASA - National Aeronautics and Space Administration
